title: VC-JCS Envelope Verifier
description: Offline verifier for W3C VC 2.0 Data Integrity (eddsa-jcs-2022 / did:key) exports produced by AINumbers tools. Decodes the did:key verificationMethod directly to Ed25519 key bytes, recomputes the JCS-canonicalized proof hash and verifies the signature, and independently recomputes every embedded execution_hash from its policy_parameters/output_payload — never trusting either the proof or the execution_hash fields as stated in the pasted document. Zero network calls anywhere in the tool.

export_document.description: A VC-JCS-wrapped export JSON (mandate/artifact plus a root-level proof block)

verification_report.description: verdict, signature check, per-receipt execution_hash recompute results, attestation_grade and signing-identity class

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_vcjcs_envelope
mcp_tool_definition.description: Independently recomputes the eddsa-jcs-2022 signature and every embedded execution_hash of a VC-JCS-wrapped export, entirely offline.
